purpose: Establish and preserve Sarallel likeness from real-photo geometry and real expression behavior. Existing Sarallel fantasy iterations are design-only and have zero facial-geometry authority.

primaryGeometrySources.role: primary facial-geometry and primary Sarallel appearance authority
primaryGeometrySources.reason: confirms Sarah-specific face geometry while preserving the preferred hair-down framing
clear exposed face perimeter for cheek width, eye spacing, nose family, mouth width, jaw and chin

appearancePriority.primary: hair-down real-photo presentation and Sarallel Likeness Master A
appearancePriority.secondary: pulled-back real-photo variant for geometry verification only
appearancePriority.rule: Pulled-back hair may not silently become the default Sarallel appearance unless explicitly revised by the user.

allowedUse: jaw movement from neutral to smile
forbiddenUse: skin color calibration from poor lighting

mayContribute: blue arcane geometry and interface-like magic

lockedAnchors: shorter rounder overall facial silhouette rather than elongated oval
rounded chin rather than pointed chin
natural adult eye scale and spacing
eyes not enlarged or dramatically upturned for fantasy stylization
broader softer nose family including base and tip
warm broad smile with distinctive cheek lift
adult age read consistent with real reference
hair-down face framing as primary Sarallel appearance
geometryOwned: nose width, bridge, base, tip, and placement

expressionAuthority.neutral: open, approachable, natural adult expression without generic fantasy-model severity
expressionAuthority.signatureSmile: wide warm smile; cheeks lift strongly; eyes narrow slightly from natural cheek compression; mouth corners rise without narrowing the face
expressionAuthority.rule: Expression may animate the locked face geometry but may not replace it with glamorized fantasy-heroine geometry.

hardReject: legacy Sarallel iteration face used as likeness authority
hair-up substitution as default Sarallel presentation
hairline or face-framing redesign that weakens Sarah recognition

productionProgression.currentStage: HeroCel rendering-only recalibration after rejected attempt 01
